# ghost/kana-quiz

The Kana Quiz (F-Droid): read the kana question and its answer choices, answer, read the score. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/kana-quiz
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/kana-quiz get_question --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/kana-quiz answer --device <serial> --param choice=<choice>
ghost skill run ghost/kana-quiz get_score --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `get_question`: Show me the current kana quiz question
- `answer`: Answer a in the kana quiz
- `get_score`: What is my kana quiz score?
